context:
Treat M5 as a product contract question first and a code question second.
Use runtime tool-list evidence when available. For the confirmed N1 drift,
derive MCP help from chart and template registries so help text changes with
the actual supported surfaces.
description:
Independent verification partially confirmed a product-surface concern: the
installed external dependency `textcharts==0.1.2` ships its own MCP server
with raw primitive tools such as `textcharts_bar`, while BenchBox ships
result-aware MCP tools `suggest_charts` and `generate_chart`.

Static repository inspection at SHA a63ae1a76 found that BenchBox's MCP
server registers BenchBox tool groups only and does not directly register or
forward textcharts MCP tools. However, the broader harness/session may expose
both MCP surfaces independently. That runtime exposure cannot be settled from
source alone.

The same review confirmed a smaller drift surface: BenchBox MCP docstrings
hardcode chart/template examples while CLI help derives chart/template choices
from registries. This TODO makes the MCP boundary explicit and ensures help
text comes from the registry/template sources selected by the chart-registry
TODO.

anti_patterns.dont: claim BenchBox registers textcharts MCP tools unless the runtime tool list proves it.
hide an externally configured MCP server from user tooling by changing BenchBox source alone.
leave hardcoded template prose after adding or changing templates.
mix raw textcharts primitive names into BenchBox chart-type validation.

deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] non-actionable: 'Build an MCP schema generator for every BenchBox tool' is a broad aspirational infra effort out of the viz item's scope, with no concrete design, owner, or committed driver.
deferrals.summary: Build an MCP schema generator for every BenchBox tool

preserves.behavior: BenchBox MCP `generate_chart` and `suggest_charts` remain result-file-aware tools.
BenchBox semantic chart IDs remain distinct from textcharts primitive command names.
FastMCP tool descriptions remain readable and useful after any generated-help change.
No textcharts MCP tool registration is added or removed without runtime evidence and a product decision.

benchbox/mcp/server.py: BenchBox MCP instructions - update the user-facing charting surface here.
benchbox/mcp/tools/discovery.py: current chart metadata returned by discovery - align with the visualization registry.
benchbox/mcp/tools/visualization.py: result-aware `suggest_charts` and `generate_chart` tools - keep semantic chart namespace here.
docs/reference/public-contracts.md: support-tier map for MCP tool contracts - extend with visualization surface boundaries.

work_units.notes:
Revalidated against checked SHA
`4d436d76e4f2bd59a2a0588afb66ac672ff0605d` with installed
`textcharts==0.1.2`. Source inspection shows BenchBox registers
`register_visualization_tools()` from `benchbox/mcp/server.py`; it does
not import or forward `textcharts.mcp_server`. The installed dependency
exposes a separate `textcharts-mcp` server with `textcharts_*` primitive
tools. Runtime FastMCP inspection observed 12 BenchBox tools
(`generate_chart`, `suggest_charts`, and other BenchBox tools) and 17
separate textcharts tools when creating the textcharts server directly.
work_units.summary: Revalidate actual MCP tool exposure and help-text drift against the current branch/runtime

work_units.notes:
Updated public contracts and MCP reference docs to classify BenchBox
`generate_chart`/`suggest_charts` as result-file-aware semantic charting.
Textcharts MCP tools are documented as a separate raw primitive server
namespace if a user configures that server independently.
work_units.summary: Record the product contract between raw textcharts MCP tools and BenchBox result-aware MCP tools

work_units.notes:
Added stable module-level MCP help constants in
`benchbox/mcp/tools/visualization.py`, derived from
`CHART_TYPE_DESCRIPTIONS` and `list_templates()`, and passed them to
FastMCP as explicit tool descriptions.
work_units.summary: Generate or centralize MCP chart/template help text from registries

work_units.notes:
Updated server instructions and chart discovery metadata to identify the
complete BenchBox semantic chart registry, supported ASCII output, and
textcharts as an external namespace. Discovery does not advertise raw
textcharts primitive IDs as BenchBox chart types.
work_units.summary: Align MCP server instructions and discovery metadata with the chosen chart-surface contract
